0097eebcdab9.name: Relentless Assault
0097eebcdab9.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of your DEATHWATCH BIKER units, or one of your KILL TEAM units with a Veteran Biker or Outrider in it, Falls Back. That unit can still charge this turn even though it Fell Back.

0148cb39a448.name: 2. Paragon of their Chapter
0148cb39a448.plain: This WARLORD takes one of the Space Marines Chapter Warlord Traits, with DEATHWATCH put in place of every mention of that Chapter's keyword. If this WARLORD wears the heraldry of one of those Chapters, or of one of their successor Chapters (other than Crimson Fists, Black Templars and Flesh Tearers), you have to pick that Chapter's trait. A Chapter Warlord Trait from a Codex supplement can't be chosen.

0ab53c4f942f.name: Kill Team Abilities
0ab53c4f942f.plain:
• Only the Outriders in this unit benefit from the Devastating Charge ability.
• Outriders can use the Turbo-boost ability only when every model in their unit is an Outrider (for example, after using the Combat Squads ability).

0af40a615071.name: Neural Shroud
0af40a615071.plain: The bearer's Psychic Hood ability has a range of 24".

0b672cb8be28.name: Kill Team Abilities
0b672cb8be28.plain:
• The Omni-scramblers ability works only while this unit has any Infiltrators or Infiltrator Sergeants in it.
• Only the Incursors in this unit benefit from the Multi-spectrum Array ability.
• The Terror Troops ability works only while this unit has any Reivers in it.

0cc1f09d5670.name: The Armour Indomitus
0cc1f09d5670.plain:
• The bearer gets 1 extra wound (add 1 to its Wounds characteristic).
• The bearer's save is 2+.
• Once per battle, just before a saving throw is made for the bearer, you can switch on its armour's force field. If you do, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

0cd19d97c5c4.name: Overkill
0cd19d97c5c4.plain: Use in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, after one of your DEATHWATCH units has made attacks against a NECRONS unit. Your opponent subtracts 1 from Reanimation Protocol rolls made for that NECRONS unit because of those attacks.

0ece3595784f.name: 2. Fortified With Contempt
0ece3595784f.plain: Blessing, warp charge 6. If manifested, choose a DEATHWATCH INFANTRY or DEATHWATCH BIKER unit from your army within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, roll one D6 each time one of its models would lose a wound; on a 5+ it keeps that wound.

0f0ee3618010.name: Black Vault Bolts
0f0ee3618010.plain:
Use in your Shooting phase, when you choose one of your STRIKE FORCE KILL TEAM or STRIKE FORCE CHARACTER units to shoot. Until the end of the phase:
• Every bolt weapon carried by the unit's models becomes Type Heavy 1.
• For ranged attacks by its models with a Bolt weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals 1 mortal wound to the target as well as the normal damage. No more than 6 mortal wounds per phase can be caused this way.

0f176b0c9376.name: Adept of the Omnissiah
0f176b0c9376.plain:
This WARLORD can patch up IRON HANDS VEHICLE models, or heals more with its repairs if it is a TECHMARINE.
• At the end of your Movement phase, if this WARLORD isn't a TECHMARINE, it can repair one of your IRON HANDS VEHICLE models within 1" of it, which regains 1 lost wound. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.
• If this WARLORD is a TECHMARINE, its Blessing of the Omnissiah ability restores up to D3+1 lost wounds to the model being repaired, instead of D3.

103ef6165951.name: Deathwatch combi-plasma (Plasma Gun - Supercharge)
103ef6165951.plain: If any attack with this weapon profile has an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer is destroyed once it has finished shooting with this weapon.

108bed1c5c67.name: Xenos Bane (Aura)
108bed1c5c67.plain: Aura: while one of your STRIKE FORCE KILL TEAM or STRIKE FORCE CHARACTER units is within 6" of this WARLORD, it has the Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic. If that unit already has a Chapter Tactic or Successor Tactic you picked at the start of the battle round through the Veterans of the Long Vigil ability, it has both that tactic and Xenos Hunters.

11c9a7af616e.name: Deathwatch Heavy Flamer (Hellfire)
11c9a7af616e.plain: Unless the target has the VEHICLE or TITANIC keyword, a wound roll of 2+ always succeeds for attacks with this weapon profile.

15ae45565fdd.name: The Vox Espiritum
15ae45565fdd.plain: Primaris models only. The bearer's aura abilities get 3" more range, up to a maximum of 9". Aura abilities that are psychic powers don't get this extra range.

1954b2f46e1f.name: The Emperor's Judgement
1954b2f46e1f.plain:
Your opponent can't re-roll the hit, wound or damage rolls of attacks that target the bearer.
The bearer also has this ability: The Emperor's Judgement (Aura): whenever a Morale test is taken for an enemy unit within 6" of the bearer, roll one extra D6 and throw away the lowest result.

1b0c88a16eb3.name: Adaptive Tactics
1b0c88a16eb3.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, if one of your WATCH MASTER units is on the battlefield: change which Battlefield Role your army has selected for the Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic.

24687a833685.name: 3. Nowhere to Hide (Aura)
24687a833685.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick an enemy unit to lose cover against your DEATHWATCH CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD until your next Command phase. The enemy unit can be anywhere on the battlefield. Until your next Command phase starts, while one of your DEATHWATCH CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, the chosen unit gets no benefit of cover to its saving throws against attacks by models in that DEATHWATCH CORE unit.

26f00530ec27.name: Purgatus
26f00530ec27.plain:
• Models in this unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks against enemy units with the HQ Battlefield Role.
• If the HQ Battlefield Role is the one you picked for the Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic, models in this unit can re-roll the wound roll for attacks against enemy units with that Battlefield Role.

285108f039d4.name: Angel Artifice
285108f039d4.plain: The bearer's Save characteristic is 2+, and it gets 1 extra point of Wounds and of Toughness (add 1 to each).

2f46e54334f8.name: Watch Master
2f46e54334f8.plain: In your Command phase, choose one of your DEATHWATCH CORE or DEATHWATCH CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, that unit's models can re-roll the hit roll whenever they attack.

30b8392985bd.name: Special-issue Loadout
30b8392985bd.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when you choose one of your DEATHWATCH INFANTRY units to shoot. Until the end of the phase, every bolt weapon that the unit's models are equipped with and that lacks the Special-issue Ammunition ability (bolt sniper rifles excepted) gains that ability, and its Type becomes Heavy 1.

33f9c08b9d46.name: Infernum halo-launcher
33f9c08b9d46.plain: If a ranged attack from an AIRCRAFT model is allocated to the bearer, add 1 to the bearer's armour saving throw against it.

350a61959466.name: Beastslayer
350a61959466.plain:
This WARLORD fights better against MONSTER and VEHICLE units.
• Add 1 to its Attacks characteristic while it is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE units.
• Its attacks against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit add 1 to both the hit roll and the wound roll.

3fca467576b8.name: Kill Team Keywords
3fca467576b8.plain: • As long as every model in an INDOMITOR KILL TEAM unit is an Inceptor, the unit gains the FLY keyword.

4600fe3535ce.name: Echo of the Ravenspire
4600fe3535ce.plain: Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, if this Warlord is more than 6" from every enemy model, it can vanish: remove it from the battlefield. At the end of your next Movement phase, set it up again anywhere more than 9" from every enemy model. If the battle ends while this Warlord is off the battlefield, it is destroyed.

4660620ed76e.name: Deadly Hunter
4660620ed76e.plain: Once this Warlord has made a charge move, you can choose an enemy unit within 1" of it and roll one D6. On a 2+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

4698117fda17.name: Malleus
4698117fda17.plain:
• Models in this unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks against enemy units with the Heavy Support, Lord of War or Dedicated Transport Battlefield Role.
• If the Heavy Support, Lord of War or Dedicated Transport Battlefield Role is the one you picked for the Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic, models in this unit can re-roll the wound roll for attacks against enemy units with that Battlefield Role.

47f828be03d2.name: 1. Vigilance Incarnate
47f828be03d2.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your DEATHWATCH CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD to re-roll wound rolls of 1 against one Battlefield Role. When you do, choose a Battlefield Role. Until your next Command phase starts, each time a model in that unit attacks an enemy unit with that Battlefield Role, re-roll a wound roll of 1.

4ac89b60ebaa.name: Inspired Retribution (Aura)
4ac89b60ebaa.plain: Aura: while one of your ULTRAMARINES CORE or ULTRAMARINES CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, roll one D6 whenever a melee attack destroys one of that unit's models. On a 6, once the attacking enemy unit has fought, it suffers 1 mortal wound.

4b2775349b29.name: Mortis Machina
4b2775349b29.plain: Against a VEHICLE unit, each attack with this weapon that the target fails its saving throw against also inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target, on top of the normal damage.

4c7c5c5e326e.name: Veterans of the Long Vigil
4c7c5c5e326e.plain:
• At the start of each battle round, you can choose one Chapter Tactic or Successor Tactic from the Space Marines codex. If you do, this unit swaps Xenos Hunters for that tactic until the next battle round starts.
• Each Chapter Tactic or Successor Tactic can be chosen this way only once per battle (tactics chosen for the Brotherhood of Veterans Stratagem don't count towards this).
• If you use the Brotherhood of Veterans Stratagem while your army's STRIKE FORCE KILL TEAM and STRIKE FORCE CHARACTER units are on a Chapter Tactic other than Xenos Hunters, the tactic chosen for the Stratagem replaces the one chosen at the start of this battle round.

4d4b6fbf7ce8.name: 4. Psychic Cleanse
4d4b6fbf7ce8.plain: Witchfire, warp charge 6. If manifested, roll one D6 per enemy model within 9" of this PSYKER. Each 6 deals 1 mortal wound to the unit that model belongs to.

5004ec8e6133.name: Special-issue Ammunition
5004ec8e6133.plain:
When a unit is chosen to shoot and it has any models equipped with a weapon that has this ability, each such weapon can fire special-issue ammunition before you pick any targets. For each weapon that does, choose one of the ammunition types below; until the end of the phase, every time that weapon fires, it uses that ammunition's modifiers and abilities:
• Dragonfire Bolts: the target gets no benefit of cover against each attack.
• Hellfire Rounds: add 1 to the wound roll of each attack, unless the target unit has the VEHICLE or TITANIC keyword.
• Vengeance Rounds: add 1 to each attack's Damage characteristic.
• Kraken Bolts: each attack gets 6" more Range, and its Armour Penetration characteristic is improved by 1 (this stacks with the Armour Penetration bonus from the Combat Doctrines ability).

52d5e7edc351.name: Teeth of Terra
52d5e7edc351.plain: Only for a model with an Astartes chainsword. The bearer's Astartes chainsword is swapped for the Teeth of Terra.

54b0315e7c33.name: Prognosticating Volley
54b0315e7c33.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your DEATHWATCH units is chosen to shoot. Until the end of the phase, its models' ranged attacks against AELDARI units can ignore any or all modifiers to the hit roll and to Ballistic Skill.

581228f8a158.name: Indomitor Kill Team
581228f8a158.plain: As long as every model in an INDOMITOR KILL TEAM is an Inceptor, the unit gains the FLY keyword.

5f6c984eb3a5.name: Battlefield Teleportation
5f6c984eb3a5.plain: Use at the start of your Movement phase: choose one of your STRIKE FORCE KILL TEAM or STRIKE FORCE CHARACTER units and take it off the battlefield. When you reach the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, you can put it back anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from every enemy model. If it is still off the battlefield when the battle ends, it counts as destroyed.

60003867bb63.name: Rites of Battle (Aura)
60003867bb63.plain: Aura: while one of your DEATHWATCH CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

61c855034f7e.name: Deathwatch combi-melta (Meltagun)
61c855034f7e.plain: Attacks with this weapon profile against a unit within half range have a Damage characteristic of D6+2.

61f17b9e7611.name: Kill Team Keywords
61f17b9e7611.plain:
• As long as a PROTEUS KILL TEAM unit has any Vanguard Veterans in it, the unit has the MELTA BOMBS keyword. If every model in it is a Vanguard Veteran with a jump pack, it also gains the FLY keyword.
• As long as every model in it is a Deathwatch Terminator, it gains the TERMINATOR keyword.
• As long as every model in it is a Veteran Biker, it gains the BIKER keyword and no longer has the INFANTRY keyword.

6e7394835049.name: Reliquary of Gathalamor
6e7394835049.plain: Primaris models only. The bearer gains this ability: Reliquary of Gathalamor (Aura): subtract 1 from Psychic tests taken for any enemy Psyker unit while it is within 18" of the bearer. Whenever that unit fails a Psychic test, roll one D6: on a 4+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

70ff753641b6.name: Purgatorus
70ff753641b6.plain: Only for a model carrying an absolver bolt pistol, bolt pistol, heavy bolt pistol or master-crafted special issue bolt pistol. This Relic, Purgatorus, takes that pistol's place and uses its own weapon profile.

710db0bd2987.name: Fortis Kill Team
710db0bd2987.plain: As long as every model in a FORTIS KILL TEAM is an Outrider, the unit gains the BIKER keyword and no longer has the INFANTRY keyword.

7282ad527e3c.name: Fiery Conviction
7282ad527e3c.plain: Whenever this model recites a litany, add 1 to the roll that decides whether the litany is inspiring.

73c981e06ac2.name: Kill Team Abilities
73c981e06ac2.plain:
• Deathwatch Terminators can use the Teleport Strike ability only when every model in their unit is a Deathwatch Terminator (for example, after using the Combat Squads ability).
• Veteran Bikers can use the Turbo-boost ability only when every model in their unit is a Veteran Biker (for example, after using the Combat Squads ability).

7920b9fa96f9.name: The Shield Eternal
7920b9fa96f9.plain:
Only for models with a storm shield, relic shield or combat shield; this Relic takes the place of that shield.
• The bearer gets a 4+ invulnerable save.
• Add 1 to its armour saving throws.
• Each time it would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 5+ it keeps that wound.

79d49fad7c5a.name: Disruptive Launch
79d49fad7c5a.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of these units from your army Falls Back: a DEATHWATCH JUMP PACK unit, an INDOMITOR KILL TEAM unit with an Inceptor in it, or a PROTEUS KILL TEAM unit with a Vanguard Veteran with jump pack in it. That unit can still shoot this turn even though it Fell Back.

7c033dbcf329.name: Hellfire Extremis (Flamer)
7c033dbcf329.plain: Attacks with this weapon hit the target automatically. Unless the target has the VEHICLE or TITANIC keyword, a wound roll of 2+ always succeeds for these attacks.

7cca6b7bbfa0.name: Auspex Array
7cca6b7bbfa0.plain: The targets of the bearer's ranged attacks get no benefit of cover against those attacks.

7fd34a246fc7.name: Stem the Green Tide
7fd34a246fc7.plain:
Use in the Charge phase, after an enemy ORK unit declares a charge that targets one or more of your DEATHWATCH units.
• Every DEATHWATCH unit targeted by that charge can fire Overwatch at the ORK unit.
• Until the end of the phase, if Overwatch kills any of that ORK unit's models, subtract 2 from its charge rolls.

81fef9d231a7.name: Proteus Kill Team
81fef9d231a7.plain:
• As long as every model in a PROTEUS KILL TEAM unit is a Vanguard Veteran with a jump pack, the unit gains the FLY keyword.
• As long as every model in it is a Deathwatch Terminator, it gains the TERMINATOR keyword.
• As long as every model in it is a Veteran Biker, it gains the BIKER keyword and no longer has the INFANTRY keyword.

8208f983c5ef.name: Teeth of Terra
8208f983c5ef.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it can make 3 extra attacks with this weapon.

8249960a9742.name: Mission Tactics
8249960a9742.plain:
If every unit in your army has the DEATHWATCH keyword (UNALIGNED units don't count), every unit in a DEATHWATCH Detachment that has the Combat Doctrines ability also gains this Mission Tactics ability:
Ignore the usual Space Marines rules for deciding which combat doctrine is active each battle round. Instead, at the start of each battle round, pick any one of the Devastator Doctrine, Tactical Doctrine or Assault Doctrine; it is active for your army until that battle round ends. There is no limit on how many times you can pick each doctrine.

waive.3: "three times" is a pick limit the Rules update removed; the plain text says there is no limit
waive.2023: date of the dataslate that made the change, not part of the rule

8300d8a4a056.name: Kill Team Keywords
8300d8a4a056.plain:
• As long as a SPECTRUS KILL TEAM has any Infiltrator or Incursor models in it, the unit has the SMOKESCREEN keyword.
• As long as it has any Reivers in it, it has the SHOCK GRENADES keyword.

837135d9ab14.name: Ghostweave Cloak
837135d9ab14.plain:
Phobos models with a camo cloak only.
• Whenever the bearer Advances, Falls Back or makes a Normal Move, it can move through models as though they weren't there.
• Subtract 1 from the hit roll of attacks that target the bearer.

83cf2fbffb20.name: Teleportarium
83cf2fbffb20.plain: Use during deployment: pick one of your DEATHWATCH INFANTRY, DEATHWATCH DREADNOUGHT or DEATHWATCH BIKER units. Every model in it gains the Teleport Strike ability. You can use this Stratagem only once per battle, but twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

871aede9c84b.name: Venator
871aede9c84b.plain:
• Models in this unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks against enemy units with the Fast Attack or Flyer Battlefield Role.
• If the Fast Attack or Flyer Battlefield Role is the one you picked for the Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic, models in this unit can re-roll the wound roll for attacks against enemy units with that Battlefield Role.

87250d27ddcc.name: Mixed Unit
87250d27ddcc.plain: If models in this unit have different Toughness characteristics, use the Toughness of most of the unit's models to work out the wound roll needed for every attack made against this unit. If two or more Toughness values tie for the most models, the player who controls this unit picks which of them counts.

8827816cf98c.name: 6. Severance
8827816cf98c.plain:
Malediction, warp charge 7. If manifested, choose one enemy CHARACTER unit within 18" of this PSYKER.
• It suffers 1 mortal wound.
• Until your next Psychic phase starts, its aura abilities reach 3" less far. If the Psychic test result beat that CHARACTER unit's Leadership characteristic, then instead, until your next Psychic phase starts, enemy units get no benefit from its aura abilities at all.

8c18fd703639.name: Kill Team Abilities
8c18fd703639.plain: • When this unit uses the Total Obliteration ability, only its Eradicators can shoot twice.

8c1e3e7adf5a.name: The Honor Vehement (Aura)
8c1e3e7adf5a.plain: Aura: while one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of the bearer, whenever that unit fights, its models get 1 extra attack (add 1 to their Attacks characteristic) until that fight is over. This doesn't stack with the extra attack from the Shock Assault ability.

waive.125: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

8c7414d82e3d.name: Sanction of the Black Vault
8c7414d82e3d.plain: Once per battle, before the battle while you are mustering your army, if your army's WARLORD is a DEATHWATCH model (has that keyword): choose one DEATHWATCH model in your army whose profile includes the word 'Sergeant'. Even though it isn't a CHARACTER, it can take one of these Relics of the Watch Fortresses: Artificer Armour, Master-crafted Weapon, Digital Weapons, Banebolts of Eryxia or Artificer Bolt Cache. No two Relics in your army can be the same, and this Stratagem can't give a model a second Relic.

8ca3b7f64e8a.name: Crimson Fists: Refuse to Die
8ca3b7f64e8a.plain: The first time this WARLORD is destroyed, you can roll one D6 at the end of the phase; on a 4+, it returns with D3 wounds remaining. If you choose to roll, you do so instead of using any rules that trigger when a model is destroyed (for example, the Only in Death Does Duty End Stratagem). On a 4+, set this WARLORD up again as close as possible to where it was destroyed and more than 1" from all enemy models.

8dedf3e64b89.name: Acquittal
8dedf3e64b89.plain: Against an INFANTRY unit, attacks with this weapon have a Damage characteristic of 4 and always wound on an unmodified roll of 2+.

91174cabd3a2.name: Deathwatch Heavy Flamer
91174cabd3a2.plain: Pick one of the profiles below before you choose targets, and make the attacks with that profile. Attacks with this weapon hit the target automatically.

9461d7e760aa.name: Pennant of the Fallen
9461d7e760aa.plain: When a friendly model is destroyed and gets to make attacks because of the bearer's Astartes Banner ability, it can make 2 attacks with one of its melee weapons, not 1.

9b990350b762.name: Chapter Tactics
9b990350b762.plain:
Deathwatch: Xenos Hunters
• Models with this tactic re-roll hit rolls of 1 when making melee attacks against TYRANIDS, AELDARI, ORK, NECRONS or T'AU EMPIRE units.
• Once both armies have been fully deployed, pick one Battlefield Role. For the rest of the battle, models with this tactic re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks against enemy units with that Battlefield Role.

9d4d276a63b6.name: Battle-psyker
9d4d276a63b6.plain: Whenever this model tries to manifest Smite or a Witchfire psychic power, add 1 to the Psychic test.

9fedbeb8fdf2.name: Specialism Extremis

a335a9dcb3d9.name: Priest
a335a9dcb3d9.plain: This model knows the Litany of Hate plus one more litany of your choice from the Litanies of Battle. In your Command phase, while it is on the battlefield, it can recite one of its litanies that no friendly model has recited yet this turn. Roll one D6: on a 3+ the litany is inspiring, and it applies until your next Command phase starts.

a5382f1ca4d5.name: Black Shield
a5382f1ca4d5.plain: If a Black Shield has two melee weapons from the Deathwatch Equipment list, its Attacks characteristic becomes 4.

waive.13: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

a9125acc0456.name: 1. Premorphic Resonance
a9125acc0456.plain:
Blessing, warp charge 6. If manifested, choose one friendly DEATHWATCH unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts:
• Its Overwatch attacks hit on 5+.
• If, at the start of the Fight phase, it is within Engagement Range of any enemy models, it gets to fight first that phase.
• Add 1 to the hit roll of melee attacks made by its models.

aa5dc00c36d0.name: Targeting Scramblers
aa5dc00c36d0.plain: Use in your opponent's Shooting phase, after a T'AU EMPIRE unit has finished its shooting attacks against one of your DEATHWATCH units: remove every markerlight counter from that DEATHWATCH unit.

acca89ba71c2.name: Brotherhood of Veterans
acca89ba71c2.plain: Use in your Command phase: choose one of your DEATHWATCH units and one Chapter Tactic or Successor Tactic. That unit's models swap the Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic for the one you chose until the turn ends.

ad9da8a4bc08.name: Furor
ad9da8a4bc08.plain:
• Models in this unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks against enemy units with the Troops Battlefield Role.
• If the Troops Battlefield Role is the one you picked for the Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic, models in this unit can re-roll the wound roll for attacks against enemy units with that Battlefield Role.

b1ef3b8929d8.name: Combat Doctrines
b1ef3b8929d8.plain:
This unit gets a bonus from whichever combat doctrine your army has active, but only if every unit in your army has the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword (AGENT OF THE IMPERIUM and ALIGNED units don't count).
Which doctrine is active:
• In the first battle round, the Devastator Doctrine is active.
• From the second battle round onwards, at the start of each battle round you can either move on to the next doctrine in the order Devastator, Tactical, Assault, or keep the doctrine that is already active. You are never forced to move on, so the Devastator or Tactical Doctrine can stay active.
The bonuses:
• Devastator Doctrine: improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of every Heavy and Grenade weapon this unit's models are equipped with by 1.
• Tactical Doctrine: improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of every Rapid Fire and Assault weapon this unit's models are equipped with by 1.
• Assault Doctrine: improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of every Pistol and Melee weapon this unit's models are equipped with by 1.
Unless a rule says otherwise, this bonus doesn't stack with other rules that improve a weapon's Armour Penetration characteristic (for example, the Storm of Fire Warlord Trait).

waive.3: "third battle round" belongs to the old fixed sequence that the Rules update replaced; the plain text describes the updated rule
waive.4: "fourth battle round" belongs to the old fixed sequence that the Rules update replaced; the plain text describes the updated rule
waive.2023: date of the dataslate that made the change, not part of the rule

b2776aa0e17e.name: Priority Doctrine Adoption
b2776aa0e17e.plain: Only if every unit in your army has the DEATHWATCH keyword (AGENT OF THE IMPERIUM and UNALIGNED units don't count). Use in your Command phase: choose one of your DEATHWATCH units and one combat doctrine. Until your next Command phase starts, that unit gets the chosen doctrine's bonus rather than the bonus of the doctrine your army has active.

bc81ec49f422.name: Spiritual Leaders (Aura)
bc81ec49f422.plain: Aura: while one of your DEATHWATCH CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models may use this model's Leadership characteristic in place of their own.

be62ad14800e.name: Brilliant Strategist

beda6c1b139d.name: 5. Mantle of Shadow
beda6c1b139d.plain: Blessing, warp charge 6. If manifested, choose one friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit within 12" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, as long as it neither shoots nor declares a charge, enemy models can only pick it as the target of ranged attacks if it is the closest eligible unit or they are within 12" of it.

bee00b3b60b7.name: Shroud Field
bee00b3b60b7.plain: Use at the start of the first battle round: pick one of your CORVUS BLACKSTAR units. Until the end of that battle round, it can't be chosen as the target of ranged attacks unless it is the closest eligible target to the model that is shooting.

c18231126453.name: 6. The Ties That Bind (Aura)
c18231126453.plain:
Two benefits for your DEATHWATCH CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD.
• Aura: while one of your DEATHWATCH CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, you can re-roll its Morale tests.
• In your Command phase, you can pick one of your DEATHWATCH CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD. Until your next Command phase starts, it has Objective Secured. Any model in it that already has that ability counts as one extra model when working out who controls an objective marker.

c3848214478f.name: Imperial Fists: Architect of War (Aura)
c3848214478f.plain: Aura: while one of your IMPERIAL FISTS CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD has the benefits of cover, AP-1 attacks allocated to its models count as AP 0.

c52bfa1756af.name: Unflinching
c52bfa1756af.plain: This unit passes Morale tests automatically.

c8fe542c5c9f.name: 5. Castellan of the Black Vault
c8fe542c5c9f.plain: While mustering your army, you can give this WARLORD one extra Relic: Adamantine Mantle, Artificer Armour, Master-crafted Weapon or Digital Weapons. This comes on top of any other Relics it has, and every Relic in your army must still be unique.

ca994a54cf65.name: Synaptic Severance
ca994a54cf65.plain: Use in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your DEATHWATCH units is chosen to shoot or fight. Until the end of the phase, when a model in that unit attacks a TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

cd08b5cc58e4.name: 4. Optimised Priority (Aura)
cd08b5cc58e4.plain: Aura: a DEATHWATCH CORE or DEATHWATCH CHARACTER unit of yours within 6" of this WARLORD can make ranged attacks while performing an action without failing it.

cd1d96f5441f.name: Tome of Malcador
cd1d96f5441f.plain: Librarians only. The bearer knows one extra psychic power from any discipline it can use.

cff7f667f76d.name: Aquila
cff7f667f76d.plain: Once you have picked a Battlefield Role for your army's Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic, pick one more Battlefield Role. For the rest of the battle, models in this unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks against enemy units with either of those Battlefield Roles.

d093ca70d37e.name: The Primarch's Wrath
d093ca70d37e.plain: Only for a model carrying a boltgun, master-crafted boltgun or special issue bolt carbine. This Relic takes that weapon's place and uses its own weapon profile.

d0b62ba8c5f3.name: Oathkeeper
d0b62ba8c5f3.plain:
This Warlord can Heroically Intervene from further away, and move further when it does.
• It can perform a Heroic Intervention if an enemy unit is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of it.
• Its Heroic Intervention moves can be up to 6" instead of 3". The other Heroic Intervention rules all still apply.

d194cd1349a6.name: The Burning Blade
d194cd1349a6.plain: Only for a model equipped with a power sword or master-crafted power sword. This Relic takes the place of that sword and uses its own weapon profile.

d87b086bcac3.name: Deathwatch Teleport Homer
d87b086bcac3.plain: Once per battle, if this unit includes a TERMINATOR model, you can take it off the battlefield at the start of your Movement phase. When you reach the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, you can put it back either anywhere wholly within your own deployment zone, or anywhere within 3" of one of your DEATHWATCH models; either way it must be more than 9" away from all enemy models. If it is still off the battlefield when the battle ends, it counts as destroyed. If this unit has been split in two by its Combat Squads ability, only one of the two units can use this ability.

e05703924788.name: Unstoppable Champion
e05703924788.plain: Roll one D6 whenever this model would lose a wound. On a 6, it keeps that wound.

e36eff62847f.name: A Vigil Unmatched
e36eff62847f.plain: Once per battle, after you choose a DEATHWATCH CHARACTER model that isn't a named character as your WARLORD: that model gets one extra Warlord Trait from the Deathwatch Warlord Traits table. No two Warlord Traits in your army can be the same (if rolling randomly, re-roll any duplicates).

e6e5335abdbe.name: Deathwatch combi-grav (Grav-gun)
e6e5335abdbe.plain: Damage becomes 2 for any attack from this weapon that gets allocated to a model whose Save is 3+ or better.

ead153cd5aa6.name: Honoured Veteran of the Watch
ead153cd5aa6.plain:
Once per battle, before the battle while you are mustering your army, if your army's WARLORD has the STRIKE FORCE keyword: choose one DEATHWATCH model in your army whose profile includes the word 'Sergeant' (not the Watch Sergeant from KILL TEAM CASSIUS).
• That model gets 1 extra wound (add 1 to its Wounds characteristic).
• Give that model one Warlord Trait; it counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. No two Warlord Traits in your army can be the same (if rolling randomly, re-roll any duplicates).

ebd5ca70bf7d.name: Clavis
ebd5ca70bf7d.plain:
Use at the start of the Fight phase: pick one enemy VEHICLE unit within 1" of one of your WATCH MASTER units.
• That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
• Until the end of the phase, it can't fight until every eligible unit in your army has fought.

ede79495fd14.name: Lament
ede79495fd14.plain: Each attack with this weapon that wounds the target also inflicts 1 mortal wound on it, on top of the normal damage.

edfdd0c60f67.name: 3. Neural Void
edfdd0c60f67.plain:
Malediction, warp charge 7. If manifested, choose one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts:
• Its models have 1 fewer attack (subtract 1 from their Attacks characteristic).
• Whenever it declares a charge, the only unit it can choose as the charge target is the closest one.

ee381e499e1d.name: Total Obliteration
ee381e499e1d.plain: In your Shooting phase, you can declare that this unit will shoot at only one target. If you do, pick one enemy unit: models in this unit can shoot twice this phase, but only at that unit.

eef9e80803eb.name: Dominatus
eef9e80803eb.plain:
• Models in this unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks against enemy units with the Elites Battlefield Role.
• If the Elites Battlefield Role is the one you picked for the Xenos Hunters Chapter Tactic, models in this unit can re-roll the wound roll for attacks against enemy units with that Battlefield Role.

ef7bb121fd27.name: Stasis Grenade
ef7bb121fd27.plain: Once per battle only. If an attack with this weapon hits, the target suffers D6 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

f8674c51aad2.name: Standard of the Emperor Ascendant
f8674c51aad2.plain:
Ancients only.
• The bearer's Astartes Banner ability gets 3" more range.
• You can re-roll Morale tests taken for your <CHAPTER> CORE units that are within range of the bearer's Astartes Banner ability.

f8b2c04bba29.name: Kill Team Keywords
f8b2c04bba29.plain: • As long as every model in a FORTIS KILL TEAM is an Outrider, the unit gains the BIKER keyword and no longer has the INFANTRY keyword.

f9febc220020.name: Death to the Alien!
f9febc220020.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your DEATHWATCH units is chosen to fight. Until the end of the phase, as long as that unit is within Engagement Range of any NECRONS, ORK, AELDARI, TYRANIDS or T'AU EMPIRE units, its models get 1 extra attack (add 1 to their Attacks characteristic).

fa9665285549.name: Blackstar Cluster Launcher
fa9665285549.plain: In your Movement phase, once this model has finished a Normal Move or an Advance, if it is still on the battlefield, you can pick one enemy unit it moved across during that move. Roll one D6 for every model in that enemy unit (no more than ten D6 in total). The enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 6 rolled.

waive.2023: date of the dataslate that made the change, not part of the rule

fe6e1da25295.name: Atonement Through Honour
fe6e1da25295.plain: Use in your opponent's Charge phase: pick one of your DEATHWATCH units that has a Black Shield in it. This phase, it can make a Heroic Intervention as though it were a CHARACTER unit.
